patterns.title: Valid request returns expected resource
patterns.description: Call the endpoint with valid path/query parameters and valid auth. Expect 200 and a response body matching the documented schema.

patterns.title: Valid payload creates/updates resource
patterns.description: Send a fully valid request body. Expect the documented success status code (200/201/204) and, where applicable, a response body matching the schema.

patterns.title: Invalid/non-existent identifier
patterns.description: Call the endpoint with a path parameter that does not correspond to any existing resource (e.g. id=999999999). Expect 404 Not Found.

patterns.title: Malformed or missing required fields in request body
patterns.description: Omit a required field, or send a field with the wrong type. Expect 400 Bad Request with a validation error message.

patterns.title: Unsupported Content-Type
patterns.description: Send the request body with an unsupported Content-Type header (e.g. text/plain instead of application/json). Expect 400 or 415.

patterns.title: Boundary values for numeric parameters
patterns.description: Test minimum, maximum, zero, and negative values for integer/number parameters and fields.

patterns.title: Boundary values for string length
patterns.description: Test empty string, single character, and max-length (and one-over-max-length) strings for string fields.

patterns.title: Missing authentication
patterns.description: Call the endpoint without any Authorization header/credentials. Expect 401 Unauthorized.

patterns.title: Insufficient permissions
patterns.description: Call the endpoint with valid credentials that lack the required scope/role. Expect 403 Forbidden.

patterns.title: SQL injection payload
patterns.description: Submit a classic SQL injection payload (e.g. "' OR '1'='1") in string parameters/fields. Expect the request to be rejected (400) or safely handled, never a 500 or data leak.

patterns.title: Rate limiting
patterns.description: Send requests in rapid succession beyond the documented rate limit. Expect 429 Too Many Requests once the limit is exceeded.

patterns.title: Response schema validation
patterns.description: Validate that the response body matches the documented JSON schema for the given status code (required fields present, correct types).

patterns.title: Empty collection response
patterns.description: For list endpoints, verify the behavior when no resources match the query (expect 200 with an empty array, not an error).

patterns.title: Idempotent operation repeated
patterns.description: Repeat the same PUT/DELETE request twice. Expect the same end state and no error on the second call (for DELETE, typically 404 or 204 on repeat).

patterns.title: List resources with default pagination
patterns.description: Call a collection GET endpoint with no query params. Expect 200 and a JSON array (possibly empty) matching the documented item schema.

patterns.title: Create resource with all optional fields populated
patterns.description: Send a request body including every optional field, not just required ones. Expect the success status code and a response echoing all provided fields.

patterns.title: Partial update only changes targeted fields
patterns.description: PATCH a resource with a single field. Expect 200 and confirm unrelated fields remain unchanged in the response.

patterns.title: Duplicate unique field rejected
patterns.description: Create a resource with a field value (e.g. email/username) that already exists. Expect 409 Conflict or 400 with a clear validation error.

patterns.title: Wrong data type for field
patterns.description: Send a string where a number is expected (or vice versa). Expect 400 Bad Request with a schema validation error.

patterns.title: Array field at max item count
patterns.description: Send an array field at exactly its documented maxItems, and one item over. Expect success at the limit and rejection just beyond it.

patterns.title: Nested object response schema validation
patterns.description: Validate that nested objects/arrays in the response body match the documented schema, including required sub-fields and types.

patterns.title: Nullable field returns null, not omitted
patterns.description: For fields marked nullable in the schema, verify the API returns an explicit null rather than omitting the key entirely.

patterns.title: Concurrent modification / stale write
patterns.description: Update the same resource from two 'concurrent' requests using stale data (e.g. missing If-Match/ETag). Verify the API either rejects the stale write or applies last-write-wins consistently.

patterns.title: Idempotency key prevents duplicate creation
patterns.description: Send the same POST request twice with an identical idempotency key. Expect the second request to return the original resource, not create a duplicate.

patterns.title: List all pets
patterns.description: GET {{baseUrl}}/pets with no body. Expect 200 and a JSON array of pet objects.

patterns.title: Create a pet
patterns.description: POST {{baseUrl}}/pets with Content-Type: application/json and body {"name": "Max", "tag": "dog"}. Expect 201 and the created pet echoed back with an assigned id.

patterns.title: Get pet by ID
patterns.description: GET {{baseUrl}}/pets/{{petId}} with a valid petId. Expect 200 and the matching pet object.

patterns.title: Fetch a single resource by valid ID
patterns.description: Call the endpoint with a valid path parameter identifying an existing resource. Expect 200 and a response body matching the documented schema.

patterns.title: List resources with valid filter/query parameters
patterns.description: Call a collection endpoint with valid, documented query parameters (filters, sort, pagination). Expect 200 and results consistent with the applied filters.

patterns.title: Create resource with valid payload
patterns.description: Send a fully valid request body containing all required fields. Expect the documented success status (200/201) and a response body reflecting the created resource, including a generated identifier.

patterns.title: Full update replaces resource
patterns.description: Send a complete valid representation of the resource. Expect 200/204 and the resource fully replaced with the new values on subsequent GET.

patterns.title: Partial update changes only targeted fields
patterns.description: Send a partial payload with a subset of fields. Expect 200 and confirm unrelated fields remain unchanged.

patterns.title: Delete an existing resource
patterns.description: Delete a resource that exists. Expect 200/204 and confirm a subsequent GET on the same resource returns 404.

patterns.title: Non-existent identifier returns 404
patterns.description: Call the endpoint with a path parameter that does not match any existing resource (e.g. a very large or random id/UUID). Expect 404 Not Found, not a 500 error.

patterns.title: Missing required field rejected
patterns.description: Omit a required field from the request body. Expect 400 Bad Request with a validation error identifying the missing field.

patterns.title: Wrong field data type rejected
patterns.description: Send a value of the wrong type for a field (e.g. string instead of integer). Expect 400 Bad Request with a schema validation error.

patterns.title: Duplicate unique field rejected
patterns.description: Attempt to create a resource with a value that must be unique (e.g. email, username) that already exists. Expect 409 Conflict or 400 with a clear error message.

patterns.title: Unsupported Content-Type rejected
patterns.description: Send the request body with an unsupported Content-Type (e.g. text/plain instead of application/json). Expect 400 or 415 Unsupported Media Type.

patterns.title: Numeric field boundary values
patterns.description: Test zero, negative, minimum, and maximum representable values for integer/number parameters and fields, plus one value just outside any documented min/max.

patterns.title: String length boundary values
patterns.description: Test empty string, single character, exactly max-length, and max-length-plus-one for string fields with a documented maxLength.

patterns.title: Pagination parameter boundary values
patterns.description: Test page=0, page=-1, limit=0, and an extremely large limit/offset. Expect the API to clamp or reject rather than error or return unbounded results.

patterns.title: Response body matches documented schema
patterns.description: Validate that every field in the response body matches the documented type, and that no undocumented required fields are missing.

patterns.title: Nullable fields returned explicitly as null
patterns.description: For fields marked nullable, verify the API returns an explicit null value rather than omitting the key when no value is set.

patterns.title: Request without credentials rejected
patterns.description: Call the endpoint with no Authorization header/credentials at all on a protected endpoint. Expect 401 Unauthorized.

patterns.title: Insufficient role/permissions rejected
patterns.description: Call a protected endpoint using valid credentials that lack the required role/scope. Expect 403 Forbidden.

patterns.title: Idempotency key prevents duplicate creation
patterns.description: Send the identical request twice with the same idempotency key. Expect the second response to return the original resource rather than creating a duplicate.

patterns.title: Concurrent/stale write handling
patterns.description: Update the same resource using stale data (e.g. no If-Match/ETag, or an outdated version). Verify the API either rejects the stale write or applies a consistent conflict-resolution rule.
